name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Prim.exec_apply_ne
typeText:
∀ (p : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Prim) (m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem) {x : Nat},
  Ne.{1} x (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Prim.target p m) →
    Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Prim.exec p m x) (m x)

source.code:
theorem exec_apply_ne (p : Prim) (m : Mem) {x : ℕ} (h : x ≠ p.target m) : p.exec m x = m x := by
  cases p <;> simp [exec, target, Mem.write] at h ⊢ <;> simp [h]
